title: The Fire Seen From Afar
intro: Picture a dark valley at night, a distant glow flickering on the horizon, and a lone traveler moving toward that light in search of guidance, only to be addressed with a mission that will confront an empire and liberate an oppressed nation.
clues: I was set adrift as an infant in a chest upon the river under Allah's inspiration to my mother.
I was raised in the very household of the tyrant who oppressed my people.
I fled after a fatal altercation and spent years in Madyan tending flocks for hire.
I saw a fire by the mountain and was called with a voice from the blessed valley.
I was granted two mighty signs in my hands: a staff that became a serpent and a hand that shone bright white.
I stood with my brother before the ruler of Egypt and later saw the sea split apart for our escape.
